dome:
Use case: stylized-concept. Project-bound ANIMOL game environment sprite. Image 1 defines small clean game-art shapes and crisp pixel finish. Images 2 and 3 are atmosphere/motif references ONLY: an enclosed dim clock tower observatory, navy metal, antique astronomical clock mechanisms. Do not copy their characters, UI, logos, runner camera, or floor. Keep our orthographic square-grid top-down puzzle style, with upright front-facing environment props. Crisp pixel art, deliberate one-pixel stair steps at native scale, large contiguous flat clusters, upper-left light, no gradients, anti-aliasing, blur, dithering, random texture dots, glow haze or realistic shading. Strict shared Sweetie-16, only #1A1C2C #333C57 #29366F #566C86 #94B0C2 #3B5DC9 #257179 #FFCD75 #EF7D57 allowed here. Use gold very sparingly, dominant dark navy and slate blue. Actual transparent background, all areas outside object transparent, no checkerboard painted into art, no captions.
Asset: one complete wide domed observatory INTERIOR architectural frame, 3:2 canvas, centered fully visible with a small clear margin. A rounded semicircular canopy takes the upper half, four thick simple curved metal ribs run across dark indigo glass panels, a closed oval oculus at the apex. Two heavy vertical navy columns continue downward to short matching foot bases at the left and right edges. Central and lower-middle area between columns is completely transparent so a top-down puzzle board can sit in front. Suggest the interior of a solid dome enclosing the viewer, not an exterior building, not open outer space. Broad restrained panel shapes and generous quiet areas; no star speckles. Recessed cool-blue inner edge with a tiny gold accent on column capitals. Thick structural ribs shaded simply, with only one-pixel dark exterior outline. Rounded arch, NOT an angular gothic arch, NOT a theater curtain. No clock on this asset: the celestial clock will be a separate foreground decoration. No floor, gears, chains, scenery, text or people. Geometry clean and symmetric overall; keep the top and side columns connected as one architecture asset.
